# Agent Athens

> AI-curated cultural events calendar for Athens, Greece. Updated daily at 08:00 from 10+ verified venues. Data licensed CC BY 4.0.

## Browse Events

- [All Events Today](https://agentathens.netlify.app/today): Everything happening in Athens today
- [Tomorrow](https://agentathens.netlify.app/tomorrow): Events happening tomorrow
- [This Weekend](https://agentathens.netlify.app/this-weekend): All weekend events
- [This Week](https://agentathens.netlify.app/this-week): Full week overview
- [Concerts This Weekend](https://agentathens.netlify.app/concert-this-weekend): Live music this weekend
- [Open Events Today](https://agentathens.netlify.app/open-today): Free admission events today
- [Exhibitions](https://agentathens.netlify.app/exhibition): Current exhibitions in Athens
- [Theater This Week](https://agentathens.netlify.app/theater-this-week): Theater performances this week
- [Electronic Music](https://agentathens.netlify.app/electronic-concert): Electronic concerts and DJ sets

## JSON API

Every HTML page has a JSON counterpart at `/api/{slug}.json`. Useful for programmatic access.

- [All Today](https://agentathens.netlify.app/api/today.json): All events today as JSON
- [Concerts This Week](https://agentathens.netlify.app/api/concert-this-week.json): Concerts this week
- [Open Today](https://agentathens.netlify.app/api/open-today.json): Free events today
- [Exhibitions](https://agentathens.netlify.app/api/exhibition.json): All current exhibitions
- [Full Index](https://agentathens.netlify.app/api/index.json): Complete event index

## Coverage

- Geographic: Athens, Greece (Attica region)
- Types: concerts, exhibitions, cinema, theater, dance, performances, DJ sets, workshops
- Sources: 10+ verified venues and listing sites, scraped daily
- Freshness: Updated every morning at 08:00 Europe/Athens
- Structured data: Schema.org Event markup on all event pages
